<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.1867 Da. The formula that matches this mass within typical MS tolerance is C₈H₂₉NO₈ (monoisotopic mass 267.1893 Da, ≈10 ppm error). This fits the required output format CxHyOzX, where X is the hetero‑atom N.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H29O8N</final_answer>
